snippet.title: Mighty Monk
snippet.description:
Welcome to Mighty Monk, where we embark on an engaging journey through history, exploring political, sociological, and other historic events, along with intriguing facts about influential figures.

Through captivating animations, stop motion, and visually stunning content, we bring history to life, making it both educational and entertaining. Our meticulously researched videos cover a wide range of historical periods, from ancient civilizations to modern conflicts.

But we don't stop at the past – we also provide updates on current events tied to sociology and politics, bridging the gap between then and now. Our goal is to deepen your understanding of past and current affairs.

Subscribe to Mighty Monk to discover the untold stories, unravel mysteries, and appreciate the significance of events that shaped our world. Together, let's uncover the hidden gems of our shared human history in a concise, engaging format.

snippet.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
snippet.description:
Learn exactly how every air disaster happened, and why. Every case is reconstructed clue by clue, built for viewers who want to understand the failure, not just watch it unfold.

Investigating the unthinkable.

Revealing the dark truth that aviation safety improves one crash at a time, Mayday: Air Disaster investigates legendary aviation disasters to find out what went wrong and why. Based on cockpit voice recorders, accident reports, and eyewitness accounts, every episode also features interviews, gripping reenactments, and state-of-the-art CGI.

From maintenance issues and dangerous cargo to extreme weather, investigators need to find the exact cause to ensure it never happens again. They owe it to the victims, the survivors, and their families to examine every clue and ultimately crack the case.

We encourage scientific discussions and value your thoughts and questions. Your comments inspire us and help us create even better content for the channel.

Don’t forget to subscribe and turn on notifications to follow the light of science. With every new video, a fresh discovery about the world and the universe awaits you!
